from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        proposer = operator.Star(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_agents=3,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.WORKER_WIN_PROMPT, prompt_custom.WORKER_BLOCK_PROMPT, prompt_custom.WORKER_LEGAL_PROMPT],
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.AGGREGATOR_RECONSTRUCT_FIRST_PROMPT,
        )
        proposal = await proposer(problem)
        verifier = operator.Debate(
            worker_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_agents=3,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.DEBATE_VERIFY_PROMPT, prompt_custom.DEBATE_VERIFY_PROMPT, prompt_custom.DEBATE_VERIFY_PROMPT],
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.DEBATE_FINALIZE_PROMPT,
            n_rounds=2,
        )
        checked = await verifier(f"Original problem:\n{problem}\n\nInitial candidate:\n{proposal['response']}")
        repair = operator.Sequential(llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=1, prompts=[prompt_custom.FORMAT_REPAIR_PROMPT])
        fixed = await repair(f"Problem:\n{problem}\n\nCandidate answer:\n{checked['response']}")
        return fixed["response"], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }
